settlements.caseName: Christopher Russo v. OP Pharmacy, LLC a/k/a OnePoint Patient Care, LLC
settlements.shortTitle: OnePoint Patient Care data incident settlement
settlements.summary: A $2.115 million proposed settlement concerns an August 2024 OnePoint Patient Care data incident involving current and former patient information.
settlements.eligibilitySummary: Potentially applies only to a living U.S. resident whose private information may have been accessed in the August 8, 2024 incident, including people sent a OnePoint notice. The administrator must resolve class membership; this dashboard does not file claims.
settlements.proofSummary: The estimated $100 alternate cash option requires no loss documentation, but online filing requires the Unique ID and PIN from the notice; a paper form is available. Documented-loss claims up to $3,500 require reasonable records such as correspondence or receipts. Never store a Unique ID, PIN, medical information, or claim confirmation in this project.
settlements.estimatedBenefit: Estimated $100 alternate cash payment without loss documentation, or documented incident-related losses up to $3,500; cash amounts may change pro rata.
settlements.geography: United States; incident-affected status is administrator-determined
settlements.court: U.S. District Court, Western District of Kentucky, Case No. 3:24-cv-00649-RGJ
settlements.relevanceReason: Official administrator site confirms the October 8, 2026 claim deadline and notice-gated online filing. High potential value but highly eligibility-specific. No claim, login, attestation, or identifier was submitted or stored.

settlements.caseName: Jason Buhl v. Dairy Farmers of America, Inc.
settlements.shortTitle: Dairy Farmers of America data incident settlement
settlements.summary: A proposed settlement concerns a June 2025 Dairy Farmers of America data incident in which certain files with private information may have been accessed.
settlements.eligibilitySummary: Potentially applies only if your private information was compromised in the June 2025 Dairy Farmers of America data incident. A mailed or emailed notice is a strong signal, but the administrator must resolve eligibility. This dashboard does not file claims.
settlements.proofSummary: The expected $55 alternate cash option states that no proof or explanation is required. Documented-loss claims up to $4,500 require supporting records tied to the incident. The online form uses the LoginID and PIN from the notice; a paper form is also available. Do not submit a claim from this scan.
settlements.estimatedBenefit: Expected $55 alternate cash payment, or documented out-of-pocket losses up to $4,500; two years of credit monitoring is also offered.
settlements.geography: United States; class membership is administrator-determined
settlements.administrator: Settlement Administrator for Jason Buhl v. Dairy Farmers of America, Inc.
settlements.court: District Court of Wyandotte County, Kansas, Case No. WY-2026-CV-000143
settlements.relevanceReason: Official administrator homepage reconfirmed claim deadline October 14, 2026; Final Approval Hearing October 26, 2026. Opt-out/object deadlines already passed September 14, 2026. No claim was submitted on this scan.

settlements.caseName: Jones, et al. v. Lands' End, Inc.
settlements.summary: A proposed settlement concerns U.S. residents whose private information was compromised in the December 2024 Lands' End data incident.
settlements.eligibilitySummary: Potentially applies only if your private information was compromised in the December 2024 incident. A mailed or emailed notice is a strong signal, but the administrator must resolve eligibility.
settlements.proofSummary: The expected $60 alternate cash option states no proof or explanation is required; documented-loss claims up to $5,000 require supporting records. A settlement notice or administrator confirmation may be needed to establish class membership.
settlements.estimatedBenefit: Expected $60 alternate cash payment, or documented losses up to $5,000; two years of credit monitoring also offered.
settlements.court: Circuit Court for Iowa County, Wisconsin
settlements.relevanceReason: Official FAQ reconfirmed claim deadline October 22, 2026; opt-out/object deadlines October 7, 2026; Final Approval Hearing November 6, 2026 10:00 a.m. CT. No claim was submitted on this scan.

settlements.caseName: McHugh v. Equinox, Inc. and Carter v. Equinox, Inc.
settlements.summary: A proposed settlement concerns potential unauthorized access to private information in an Equinox, Inc. data incident discovered on or about April 29, 2024.
settlements.eligibilitySummary: Potentially applies only to a living U.S. resident who was sent an Equinox notice stating that private information may have been impacted by the April 2024 data incident. The administrator must resolve eligibility; this dashboard does not file claims.
settlements.proofSummary: The official notice says an estimated $100 pro rata payment may be claimed in addition to or instead of documented losses. Documented-loss claims up to $5,000 require reasonable supporting records. Class membership requires that Equinox sent an incident notice. Never store a Notice ID or submit a claim from this scan.
settlements.estimatedBenefit: Approximately $100 pro rata cash payment, documented monetary losses up to $5,000, and up to three years of one-bureau credit monitoring; cash amounts can adjust based on valid claims.
settlements.geography: United States; Equinox incident notice required
settlements.court: Supreme Court of the State of New York, Albany County, Index Nos. 911677-24 and 901198-25
settlements.relevanceReason: Official court-authorized settlement site reconfirmed claim deadline October 23, 2026; Final Approval Hearing November 12, 2026. Exclusion/object deadlines already passed September 23, 2026. No claim was submitted on this scan.

settlements.caseName: Tuccori et al. v. At World Properties, LLC et al.
settlements.summary: A $120.3345 million proposed settlement concerns commissions paid in certain U.S. home purchases involving a Multiple Listing Service and a brokerage.
settlements.eligibilitySummary: Potentially applies to people who purchased a home listed on an MLS in the United States and paid a brokerage commission during an applicable defendant-specific class period. Home sellers covered by separate seller settlements and other exclusions do not qualify.
settlements.proofSummary: The official homepage does not state the specific records required for an individual claim. Review the official notice and Claim Form for the applicable brokerage and class period before making any truthful manual filing; this dashboard stores no address, transaction, or claim data.
settlements.estimatedBenefit: Pro rata cash share of a combined $120,334,500 settlement fund; no individual payment amount is stated or guaranteed.
settlements.geography: United States; qualifying MLS-listed home purchase and brokerage commission required
settlements.court: U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois, Case No. 1:24-cv-00150
settlements.relevanceReason: Official administrator site confirms the October 27, 2026 claim deadline and a nationwide class, but eligibility depends on the brokerage and transaction-specific class period. No claim, address, or attestation was submitted.

settlements.caseName: In re Pork Antitrust Litigation (Consumer Indirect Purchaser Track)
settlements.summary: Official settlements totaling $117.065 million concern allegations that certain pork producers and related defendants conspired to inflate pork prices and restrict supply.
settlements.eligibilitySummary: Potentially applies to U.S. consumers who purchased pork products for personal consumption from June 28, 2014 through June 30, 2018, subject to the official exclusions and administrator review.
settlements.proofSummary: The official homepage does not state the individual documentation requirement. Review the official Claim Form and notice before filing and preserve only truthful purchase records you already have; this dashboard does not decide eligibility or submit claims.
settlements.estimatedBenefit: Pro rata cash share of the net settlement fund; five monetary settlements total $117.065 million, but no individual payment amount is stated or guaranteed.
settlements.geography: United States; qualifying personal-consumption pork purchases during the class period
settlements.administrator: Consumer Indirect Purchaser Pork Litigation Settlement Administrator
settlements.court: U.S. District Court for the District of Minnesota
settlements.relevanceReason: Official administrator site confirms a broad household-grocery purchase class and an October 29, 2026 deadline. Individual payment and proof requirements remain claim-form dependent. No claim or attestation was submitted.

settlements.caseName: In re ZF-TRW Airbag Control Units Products Liability Litigation
settlements.summary: A finalized settlement offers benefits to eligible current and former owners or lessees of listed Toyota vehicles.
settlements.eligibilitySummary: Potentially applies only to current or former owners or lessees, as of July 31, 2023, of specified 2011-2019 Toyota models. The official VIN lookup determines whether a vehicle is included.
settlements.proofSummary: Vehicle eligibility requires the official VIN lookup. Expense reimbursement needs receipts, invoices, or a signed affidavit; never save a VIN in this dashboard.
settlements.estimatedBenefit: Eligible recall expenses may be reimbursed; potential residual distribution is up to $250, plus specified warranty or inspection benefits.
settlements.geography: United States, District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, and U.S. territories
settlements.court: U.S. District Court, Central District of California
settlements.relevanceReason: Official administrator site confirms the settlement is finalized and being implemented, but benefits apply only to specified Toyota models and verified VINs. No VIN was entered and no claim was submitted.
